{{Quote|Base to platform. What was all that? Report!''"<br />"''Protestors against the war. We've taken care of them.|The droid commando impersonating Captain Jayfon|<ref name="hc">{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}</ref>}}
This '''BX-series droid commando''' was a member of [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] posse. He impersonated the voice of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jayfon/Legends|Jayfon]] to cover their infiltration of the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] and later wore the [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commando's]] armor during the remainder of the [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|Senate hostage crisis]]. He later successfully left the crime scene with the other members of the team and [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]].

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This droid only appearance is in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television episode [[Hostage Crisis]], where he was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]].
